input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of the Fees paid or payable by Customer during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: Section 21 meets the preferred position. The cap is expressly mutual and set at the greater of 12 months' Fees "paid or payable" and USD 1,000,000 (§21.1); "Fees" (§1.5) is a substantive base covering subscription, professional services and usage fees, so the cap is not illusory. §21.2 is a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages and helpfully confirms data-restoration, replacement-service, notification and incident-response costs are direct damages. §21.3 places outside the cap breaches of confidentiality, data-protection and security obligations, indemnification obligations, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other Party's IP, and confirms Customer's payment of undisputed Fees is not "damages" subject to the cap. §21.4 preserves liability that cannot lawfully be limited, and §18.2 confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. No one-sided or hidden liability limitation appears elsewhere in the document. No redline needed.
